column1: Acupressure, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 10ft. Target, which can be user or ally, increases one of its stats by 2 stages, randomly chosen each time.
After You, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Target will move next in the initiative order after this Pokémon's turn, regardless of the initiative order. This move has priority.
Assist, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Selects from a random move that its party members know, choosing from every move the Pokémon in the party knows.
Attract, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, the target is infatuated, bypasses Substitute.
Barrage, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; 30ft. Roll a d4+1, making a number of attacks equal to the roll. Deals 1d6 + Attack modifier damage.

Baton Pass, 30 PP; Status, Normal; Self. The user swaps out of battle to an ally, transferring all negative and positive stat changes, or moves a number of feet equal to double its walking speed and transfers stat changes to a Pokémon within 10 feet of where it stops.
Belly Drum, 5 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Reducers the user's HP by half of its max HP, but its attack is maximized to +6 stages. Cannot be used if at or below half HP.
Bestow, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. User forcibly gives a held item it has to a foe. Cannot be used if the user doesn't have any held items to give, or if the foe already has a held item.

Bide, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Self. User enters a state of biding for 3 turns. On the turn it uses the move and second turn, it does nothing and bides its time. On the 3rd turn, it deals damage equal to double the damage total damage it took to a single target.

Bind, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d4 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a 1d4+1, binding the target for that amount of turns. Each turn while binded, user and target cannot move from their spaces until unbinded.
Block, 5 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Attack. On hit, blocks the foe and prevents it from switching out or moving outside of a 30 foot radius of the user.
Blood Moon, 5 PP; Special, Normal; 30ft. Deals 5d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and the move can only be used every other turn.
Body Slam, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage. On hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, the target is paralyzed.
Boomburst, 10 PP; Special, Normal; 15ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 5d10 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Breakneck Blitz; Physical or Special, Normal; Melee. Normal type Z-Move. On hit, deals 8d12 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage.
Camouflage, 20 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Changes to a single typing depending on the environment. Ex., Water type at a beach or Rock type on a mountain.
Captivate, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, lowers the Special Attack of the target by 2 stages if they are opposite gender to the user.
Celebrate, 30 PP; Status, Normal; Self. User celebrates some great accomplishment. Woohoo! Does nothing. Good job.
Chip Away, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Ignores any temporary Defense or other AC boosts of the target. Deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Comet Punch, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Roll a d4+1, making a number of attacks equal to the roll. Deals 1d6 + Attack modifier damage, and each attack can target a different individual.
Confide, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. Lower's the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Constrict, 30 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d6 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a 1d10. On a 10, the target's speed is lowered by 1 stage.
Conversion, 30 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Changes the user's type to a typing of one of the user's moves of the user's choosing.

Conversion 2, 30 PP; Status, Normal; 20ft. Targets a foe, changing the user to a type that would be immune to or resist the move it last used: ex., if the target last used an Electric type move, user would change to Ground type.
Copycat, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Uses the move that was last used by the target.
Covet, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 2d10 + Attack modifier damage and steals the target's held item if it has one and if the user isn't holding an item.
Crush Claw, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 3d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d20. On even numbers, lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

Crush Grip, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage if target is at full HP, 3d10 + Attack modifier damage if target is above half HP, or 1d12 + Attack modifier damage if the target is below half HP.
Cut, 30 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 2d10 + Attack modifier damage to target.
Defense Curl, 40 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Increases user's Defense by 1 stage, and the next use of Rollout or Ice Ball gains an additional damage die.
Disable, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, disables the last move the target used, making them unable to use it for 3 turns.
Dizzy Punch, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 3d10 + Attack modifier damage to target, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 9 or 10, the target is confused.
Doodle, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 20ft. Copies a single foe's abilities onto the user and onto all willing allies within 15ft of the user.
Double Hit, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Make two attack rolls. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Double Slap, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Roll a d4+1, making a number of attacks equal to the roll. Deals 1d6 + Attack modifier damage.
Double Team, 5 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Until the end of the user's next turn, all attacks made against it are at disadvantage.
Double Edge, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d12 + Attack modifier damage, user takes recoil equal to 1/3 of the damage dealt.

Echoed Voice, 15 PP; Special, Normal; 30ft. Deals 1d6 + Special Attack modifier damage to foe. Each consecutive round this move is used, the move gains an additional die of damage, up to a maximum of 6d6 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Egg Bomb, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; 20ft. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier damage.
Encore, 5 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, forces the target to use the move it last used for 3 turns before being freed from the encore.
Endeavor, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Reduces foe's HP to the user's current HP.

Endure, 3 PP; Status, Normal; Self. As a reaction against being dealt damage that would cause the user to fall to or below 0 HP, it instead stays up at 1 HP, and cannot fall below 1 HP until the end of the round.
Entrainment, 15 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Changes target's ability to the user's. If the target has multiple abilities, it can change different abilities with each use.

Explosion, 3 PP; Physical, Normal; 30ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 9d10 + Attack modifier damage, and the user faints. If the move misses a target, it deals half damage instead.
Extreme Evoboost; Status, Normal; Self. Eevee only Z-Move, while using Last Resort. Increases the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 2 stages each.
Extreme Speed, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; 20ft. The user moves adjacent to the target before making the attack roll. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, and the move has priority.
Facade, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 2d10 + Attack modifier damage. Increases to 4d10 + Attack modifier damage if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
Fake Out, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage and causes target to flinch and has priority. Can only be used on the first turn the Pokémon is active in a battle.
False Swipe, 30 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage, cannot damage a foe below 1 HP.
Feint, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.
Fillet Away, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Self. User takes damage equal to half of its max HP and increases its Attack, Special Attack and Speed by 2 stages.

Flail, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage if user is at or below 1/4 max HP, 3d10 + Attack modifier damage if user is below half HP, 1d12 + Attack modifier damage if the user is above half HP, or 1d12 + Attack modifier damage if the user is at full HP.
Flash, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 10ft radius. All targets in range must make a Concentration check vs. user's Style check. On a fail, targets have disadvantage on their next attack roll.
Focus Energy, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Increases the user's critical hit range by 2 (ex from 20 to 18-20). Cannot be stacked.

Follow Me, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target, with an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, targets must move toward and attack the target during the round, and this attack has priority. Allies are immune to the effects of this move.

Foresight, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 20ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, the user can hit Ghost types with Normal and Fighting moves, and all attacks made against the target for the rest of combat ignore boosts to evasion.

Frustration, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage if user hates its trainer, 3d10 + Attack modifier damage if user strongly dislikes its trainer, 2d8 + Attack modifier damage if the user dislikes its trainer or 1d10 + Attack modifier damage if the user is neutral toward its trainer.
Fury Attack, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Roll a d4+1, making a number of attacks equal to the roll. Deals 1d6 + Attack modifier damage.
Fury Swipes, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Roll a d4+1, making a number of attacks equal to the roll. Deals 1d6 + Attack modifier damage.
G-Max Cuddle; Physical or Special, Normal; 50ft. Eevee's Gigantamax move. Deals 6d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage and infatuates the target if it is of the opposite gender.

G-Max Gold Rush; Physical or Special, Normal; 50ft. Meowth's Gigantamax move. Deals 6d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage and confuses target, scattering coins and earning an additional 25% Poké after a battle.

G-Max Replenish; Physical or Special, Normal; 50ft. Snorlax's Gigantamax move. Deals 6d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage and rolling a d20 for the user and each of its allies. On evens, restores any berries consumed by the user and/or its allies.
Giga Impact, 3 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 7d12 + Attack modifier damage and forces the user to skip its next turn to recharge.
Glare, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Attack. On hit, the target is paralyzed.
Growl, 30 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft cone. Make an attack roll using Attack on each foe in range. On hit, reduce the target's Attack by 1 stage. Allies are immune to the effects of this move.
Growth, 20 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Increases user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
Guillotine, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Roll a d100. On a roll of 96 or higher, the target instantly faints.
Happy Hour, 1 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Doubles prize money earned after a battle. Does not stack with certain features and other moves that increase prize money.
Harden, 20 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Increases user's Defense by 1 stage.
Head Charge, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage, user takes recoil equal to 1/4 of the damage dealt.
Headbutt, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 3d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, the target flinches.
Heal Bell, 1 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft radius. Heals the user, allies, and Pokémon in the trainer's party in range of their status conditions.
Helping Hand, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Grants an ally's next attack an additional two damage dice, and this move has priority.
Hidden Power, 20 PP; Special, Varies; 30ft. The user's Hidden Power typing is random depending on the Pokémon itself, usually determined by the GM. Deals 3d10 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Hold Back, 30 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage, cannot damage a foe below 1 HP.

Hold Hands, 40 PP; Status, Normal; Melee. Must have an ally on the field. Holds hands with one or more allies in a show of sheer friendship and fleeting comfort. This move is useless and only provides fleeting comfort.
Horn Attack, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Horn Drill, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Roll a d100. On a roll of 96 or higher, the target instantly faints.
Howl, 30 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Raises user's Attack by 1 stage.
Hyper Beam, 3 PP; Special, Normal; 50ft line. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 7d10 + Special Attack modifier damage and forces the user to skip its next turn to recharge.
Hyper Drill, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; 20ft line. The user moves to the end of the line as part of the attack. Deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage and ignores moves such as Protect and Detect.
Hyper Fang, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 10, the target flinches.
Hyper Voice, 10 PP; Special, Normal ; 15ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Judgement, 10 PP; Special, Normal; 30ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 6d10 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Laser Focus, 20 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Attacks made by the user result in a critical hit until the end of its next turn.
Last Resort, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; 15ft. Can only be used if the user has used all of its other moves at least once. Deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage.

Leer, 30 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft cone. Make an attack roll using Attack on each foe in range. Each attack that succeeds reduces the target's Defense by 1 stage. Allies are immune to the effects of this move.
Lock-On, 3 PP; Status, Normal; Self. All of the user's attacking moves will automatically hit a target until the end of the next round.
Lovely Kiss, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 10ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On a hit, the target falls asleep.
Lucky Chant, 3 PP; Status, Normal; Self. The user and its allies are immune to extra damage dealt by critical hits for 5 rounds.
Max Guard; Status, Normal; Self. Can only be used while Dynamaxed. Protects the user from all damage until the end of the round, and the move has priority.
Max Strike; Physical or Special, Normal; 50ft. Can only be used while Dynamaxed. Deals 5d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage and lowers the Speed of all foes by 1 stage.

Me First, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. If the target hasn't acted, the user chooses one of the attacking moves the target knows and uses it, gaining an additional damage die and dealing damage equal to the move's damage + the user's Attack or Special Attack modifier.
Mean Look, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Prevents the target from switching out and from moving outside of a 30ft radius of the user.
Mega Kick, 5 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Mega Punch, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier damage.
Metronome, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Varies. The user uses a random move.
Milk Drink, 1 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Restores HP equal to half of its max HP.

Mimic, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. The target copies one of the foe's moves at random, and it replaces this move until the end of combat. Moves copied in this way only have 3 PP if they normally have more than that.
Mind Reader, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. All of the user's attacking moves will automatically hit the target until the end of the next round.
Minimize, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Increase Pokémon's evasion by 1 stage, causing all attacks against this Pokémon to have -1 attack rolls per stage.
Morning Sun, 1 PP; Status, Normal; Self. In normal weather, restores 1/2 of max HP, in harsh sunlight, restores 2/ 3 of max HP, and restores 1/4 of max HP in other weather.
Multi-Attack, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage, the type of damage changing depending on the memory the user holds.
Nature Gift, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; 30ft. Deals damage using held berry, and the user must be holding a berry to use this move.
Nature Power, 20 PP; Special, Normal; Melee. Deals damage depending on the terrain.
Noble Roar, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, hit, the target has Attack and Special Attack lowered by 1 stage.
Odor Sleuth, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Attack, and on hit, the user has advantage on attack rolls against the target until the end of the user's next turn.

Pain Split, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, the user and target's HP are added together, divided by 2, and then that value becomes the HP of both the user and target.
Pay Day, 3 PP; Physical, Normal; 30ft. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage and earns an additional 25% Poké after combat.

Perish Song, 5 PP; Status, Normal; 50ft radius. make a separate attack using Special Attack on each target. Puts a perish counter on all targets in range, starting at 4. At the end of each round, the perish counter decreases by 1, and when the perish counter hits 0, affected targets are reduced to 0 HP.
Play Nice, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Population Bomb, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; 15ft. Deals 1d4 + Attack modifier damage on hit, guaranteeing two attack rolls. Make attack rolls until one misses, up to a maximum of 10 total attacks.
Pound, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage.
Power Shift, 5 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Swaps the user's Attack and Special Attack with its Defense and Special Defense.

Present, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; 20ft. On hit, roll a d10. On a 1-2, heals the target for 1/4 of its max HP, on a 3-7, deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage, on an 8-9, deals 2d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on a 10, deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Protect, 3 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Uses a reaction to block an attack or move completely when hit. This only blocks the move that Protect is used on.
Psych Up, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. The user resets its own stat changes and copies the target's stat changes to its own.

Pulverizing Pancake; Physical, Normal; Melee. Snorlax's Z-Move, using Giga Impact. User can move a number of feet up to double the user's walking speed before making the attack roll. Deals 9d12 + Attack modifier damage.

Quick Attack, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. User can move a number of feet up to the user's walking speed before making the attack roll. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage, and the move has priority.

Rage, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage. For each consecutive turn the user uses Rage, each time the user is hit, Rage gains an additional damage die. These additional damage die reset when the user uses a move other than Rage.

Raging Bull, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; 30ft line. Make a separate attack on each target, moving to the end of the line. Deals 4d12 + Attack modifier damage, and removes the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil.

Rapid Spin, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 2d10 + Attack modifier damage and clears all binding moves and Leech Seed from the user, and field affects like Stealth Rock and Spikes within 10 feet of the user.

Razor Wind, 10 PP; Special, Normal; 20ft cone. Upon using this move, the user ends its turn, and on its next turn, it makes a separate attack on each target. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Recover, 1 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Restores HP equal to half of the user's maximum HP.
Recycle, 5 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Restores the last expended held item, such as a berry, able to use it again.
Reflect Type, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Changes the user's typing to the target's.
Refresh, 3 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Cures the user of a burn, paralysis or poison.

Relic Song, 10 PP; Special, Normal; 20ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 10, the target is put to sleep, and if used by Meloetta, it changes between Aria and Pirouette form.
Retaliate, 3 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, or 5d12 + Attack modifier damage if an ally has been knocked out in the current or last round.

Return, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 5d12 + Attack modifier damage if user adores its trainer, 4d10 + Attack modifier damage if user strongly likes its trainer, 2d10 + Attack modifier damage if the user likes its trainer or 1d12 + Attack modifier damage if the user is neutral toward its trainer.
Revelation Dance, 15 PP; Special, Normal; 20ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 5d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, the type changing depending on the user's primary type.

Revival Blessing, 1 PP; Status, Normal; 10ft. Revives a knocked out target to half of its maximum HP, or a trainer to full HP. Can also be used on a creature who has died within the past day to revive them back to life, causing the user to forget this move instantly and be unable to relearn it.

Roar, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft radius. Make an Attack based attack roll on each target. All targets hit are automatically switched out to their trainers, or must move their maximum movement distance away from the user.

Rock Climb, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; 15ft.The user moves adjacent to the target before making the attack roll. Deals 4d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 9-10, the target is confused.

Round, 15 PP; Special, Normal; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 2d10 + Special Attack modifier damage. If another individual already used Round, this Pokémon can take its turn to use Round at 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and all other individuals who use Round after the first deal the increased damage.
Safeguard, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft. User chooses up to 5 targets in range, including itself. Targets become immune to non-volatile status conditions and confusion for 5 rounds.
Scary Face, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Attack, and on hit, its Speed is reduced by 2 stages.
Scratch, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. 1d10 + Attack modifier damage on hit.
Screech, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Attack, and on hit, reduce the target's Defense by 2 stages.
Secret Power, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; 15ft. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, causes a secondary effect depending on the environment.

Self-Destruct, 3 PP; Physical, Normal; 30ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 7d12 + Attack modifier damage, and the user faints. If the move misses a target, it deals half damage instead.
Sharpen, 30 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Raises user's Attack by 1 stage.

Shed Tail, 3 PP; Status, Normal; Self. User takes damage equal to half of its max HP and creates a substitute. The substitute has HP equal to the amount of HP expended by the user to create the substitute. When individuals try to attack the user, it must attack the substitute instead. The user can attack as normal, and any Pokémon that switches in place of the user while the substitute is active gains the substitute.
Shell Smash, 5 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Decreases the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage, but increases the user's Attack, Special Attack and Speed by 2 stages.
Simple Beam, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, changes the target's ability to Simple.
Sing, 5 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft radius. make a separate attack using Special Attack on each target. On hit, targets fall asleep.
Sketch, 1 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Sketches a move that the target used, replacing Sketch with that move.
Skull Bash, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Raises user's Defense by 1 stage and ends its turn. On next turn, attacks and deals 5d10 + Attack modifier damage.
Slack Off, 1 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Restores HP equal to half of the user's max HP.
Slam, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier damage.
Slash, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, and this move crits on an attack roll of 19-20.
Sleep Talk, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Uses one of the other moves the user knows at random, only if the user is asleep.
Smelling Salts, 10 PP; Physical, Normal; 15ft. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, or 6d12 + Attack modifier damage if target is paralyzed, curing it of paralysis.

Smokescreen, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 25ft radius. Creates a cloud of smoke centered on the user. User is immune to the move, but all individuals within the smokescreen or trying to attack Pokémon in the smokescreen have their vision obscured - only able to see 10 feet in front of them while in the smoke - and all attack rolls except for the user's have disadvantage. Smokescreen dissipates after 3 rounds.
Snore, 15 PP; Special, Normal ; 20ft. Deals 2d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 8-10, the target flinches. Fails if the user is not asleep.
Soft-Boiled, 1 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft. Restores HP equal to half of the target's max HP, and this move can target the user.
Sonic Boom, 10 PP; Special, Normal; 30ft. Automatically hits and deals 20 damage exactly to the target.
Spike Cannon, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; 15ft. Roll a d4+1, making a number of attacks equal to the roll. Deals 1d5 + Attack modifier damage.

Spit Up, 5 PP; Special, Normal; 20ft. Deals 3d10 + Special Attack modifier if user has 1 stockpile, 4d10 + Special Attack modifier if the user has 2 stockpile, and 5d10 + Special Attack modifier. Removes all stockpiles and stat boosts caused by stockpile.
Splash, 50 PP; Status, Normal; Self. User flops around pathetically in a cruel display of lifeless mortality, a show of life meant to be made meaningless and outclassed. Does nothing.
Spotlight, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, all individuals within a 15ft radius of the target must move toward the target and attack it.
Stockpile, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Stockpiles 1 and increases its Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Stomp, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, the target flinches. Ignores the effects of Minimize.
Strength, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 4d12 + Attack modifier damage and knocks the target 10 feet away.

Struggle; Physical, Normal; Melee. Ignores immunities and deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage. User loses HP equal to 1/4 of its max HP. Every Pokémon can use this move, but only if it runs out of PP for all of its moves.
Stuff Cheeks, 10 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Can only be used if holding a berry. Eats held berry and increases Defense by 2 stages.

Substitute, 3 PP; Status, Normal; Self. User takes damage equal to 25% of its max HP and creates a substitute. The substitute has HP equal to the amount of HP expended by the user to create the substitute. When individuals try to attack the user, it must attack the substitute instead. The user can attack as normal, and any Pokémon that switches in place of the user while the substitute is active gains the substitute.
Super Fang, 1 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Cuts the target's HP in half.
Supersonic, 15 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, confuses the target.
Swagger, 15 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft. Make an attack roll using Attack. On hit, the target is confused but has its Attack raised by 2 stages.

Swallow, 1 PP; Status, Normal; Self. User restores to full HP if it has 3 stockpiles, half of its max HP if it has 2 stockpiles, and 2d10 HP if it has 1 stockpile. Removes all stockpiles and stat boosts caused by stockpile.

Sweet Scent, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft radius. make a separate attack using Special Attack on each target. On hit, a target must move as far as it is able toward the user on its next turn, then end its turn.
Swift, 3 PP; Special, Normal; 30ft. Automatically hits. Deals 2d12 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Swords Dance, 5 PP; Status, Normal; Self. Increases user's Attack by 2 stages.
Tackle, 30 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage.
Tail Slap, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Roll a d4+1, making a number of attacks equal to the roll. Deals 1d6 + Attack modifier damage.
Tail Whip, 30 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack using Special Attack, and on hit, reduce the target's Defense by 1 stage.
Take Down, 20 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. Deals 4d12 + Attack modifier damage, and the user takes damage equal to 1/4 of damage dealt.
Tearful Look, 20 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, reduces the foe's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
Teatime, 10 PP; Status, Normal; 20ft radius. Make an attack roll using Special Attack on all targets in range, and on hit, targets must eat held berries if they have one.
Techno Blast, 5 PP; Special, Normal; 30ft line. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 5d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and the type changes depending on the held drive.
Teeter Dance, 3 PP; Status, Normal; 15ft radius. make a separate attack based Special Attack on each target, and on hit, targets are confused.

Tera Blast, 10 PP; Special, Normal; 30ft. Deals 4d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage - whichever is higher while Terastalized, but the move is always Special when not Terastalized. Typing of move changes depending on the user's Tera typing if it is Terastalized.
Tera Starstorm, 5 PP; Special, Normal; 25ft. Deals 5d12 + Special Attack modifier damage. If the user is Terapagos and is Stellar Tera, the move is a 25ft cone instead.

Floaty Fall, 3 PP; Physical, Flying; 15ft. Pikachu only. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, target flinches.

Fly, 10 PP; Physical, Flying; Melee. On first using this move, the user flies upward and becomes semi-invulnerable to damage. On the next turn, the user can move up to double its movement speeds and make the attack against a target it moves to. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier damage.
G-Max Wind Rage; Physical or Special, Flying; 50ft. Corviknight's Gigantamax move. Deals 6d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage and removes all hazards and screens on the field.
Gust, 30 PP; Special, Flying; 30ft. Deals 1d12 + Special Attack modifier damage.

Hurricane, 10 PP; Special, Flying; 30ft. Make a separate attack on each target within a 15ft radius of the target. Deals 5d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, the target is confused. Can hit targets during Fly, Bounce and Sky Drop.

Max Airstream; Physical or Special, Flying; 50ft. Flying type max move. Deals 6d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage, and increases the Speed of the user and all allies within a 15ft radius of the user by 1 stage.
Mirror Move, 20 PP; Status, Flying; 30ft. The user can use the move that the target last used.
Oblivion Wing, 3 PP; Special, Flying; 30ft line. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 3d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and restores HP equal to 75% of the damage dealt.
Peck, 30 PP; Physical, Flying; Melee. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Pluck, 20 PP; Physical, Flying; Melee. Deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage, and if the target is holding a berry, the user eats it.
Roost, 1 PP; Status, Flying; Self. Restores HP equal to half of the user's max HP. The user loses its Flying typing for 2 turns.

Sky Attack, 5 PP; Physical, Flying; 20ft. The user ends its turn after using this move. On the next turn, the user attacks, and moves adjacent to the target before making the attack roll. Deals 6d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, the target flinches.

Sky Drop, 10 PP; Physical, Flying; Melee. The user grabs the target - which can be an ally - and lifts it into the sky, becoming semi-invulnerable. On the next turn, drops the target, doing no damage if the target was a Flying type or an ally. Deals 3d10 + Attack modifier damage.
Supersonic Skystrike; Physical or Special, Flying; 30ft. Flying type Z-Move. Deals 8d12 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage.
Tailwind, 5 PP; Status, Flying; Self. Creates a tailwind around the user and its allies. For 4 turns, the user and its allies have their Speed and movement speeds doubled.
Wing Attack, 30 PP; Physical, Flying; Melee. Deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Agility, 30 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Increases the user's Speed by 2 stages and movement speeds by 5 feet.

Ally Switch, 15 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. The user swaps places with the target, but the target must be an ally. If the ally is unwilling, the user must select a different move or a different ally to swap with.
Amnesia, 20 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Increases the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.
Barrier, 20 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Increases the user's Defense by 2 stages.
Calm Mind, 20 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Increases the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Confusion, 20 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 2d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 10, the target is confused.
Cosmic Power, 20 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Increases the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Dream Eater, 3 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Only works if the target is asleep. Automatically hits a sleeping target and deals 5d10 + Special Attack modifier damage and restores HP equal to half of the damage dealt.
Eerie Spell, 3 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 3d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and decreases the PP of the target's last used move by 3 PP.

Esper Wing, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft line. Make a separate attack on each target in two different 15ft lines, which the user aims in any direction. Deals 3d10 + Special Attack modifier damage. Crits on a 19-20, and increases the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Expanding Force, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 25ft. Deals 3d10 + Special Attack modifier damage. In Psychic Terrain, range is a 25ft cone and deals 5d10 + Special Attack modifier damage instead.
Extrasensory, 20 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 3d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 10, the target flinches.
Freezing Glare, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 10, the target is frostbitten.
Future Sight, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Two rounds after using this move, the target automatically takes 5d12 + Special Attack modifier damage.
G-Max Gravitas; Physical or Special, Psychic; 50ft. Orbeetle's Gigantamax move. Deals 6d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage and intensifies the gravity of the field.

Genesis Supernova; Special, Psychic; 30ft radius. Mew's Z-Move, using Psychic. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 8d12 + Special Attack modifier damage. Creates psychic terrain centered on the user.
Glitzy Glow, 3 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft. Eevee only. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and creates a light screen around the user.

Gravity, 5 PP; Status, Psychic; 50ft radius. Creates a field of intense gravity. Grounds all individuals, preventing them from flying or hovering, and the moves Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash and Telekinesis automatically fail.
Guard Split, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Averages the user and target's Defense and Special Defense, then sets the user and target's Defense and Special Defense to the average.
Guard Swap, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Swaps the target's Defense and Special Defense with the user's Defense and Special Defense.
Heal Block, 15 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, the target is prevented from being healed for 5 turns.
Heal Pulse, 1 PP; Status, Psychic; 5ft radius. Restores HP of all targets in range equal to half of the target's max HP, including the user.
Healing Wish, 1 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. The user faints. The next Pokémon to become active or another active Pokémon heals to full HP and is cured of all status conditions.
Heart Stamp, 20 PP; Physical, Psychic; Melee. Deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, the target flinches.

Heart Swap, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Selects two targets, which cannot include the user. The targets swap souls, and the targets use the stats, moves, stat stages, species, and all other statistics of the target it was Heart Swapped with. If a target is an owned Pokémon or other trainer, a player temporarily gains access to the swapped Pokémon or trainer's sheet for use. The effects of Heart Swap end after a battle, and it can affect both Pokémon and trainers. If Heart Swap is used outside of combat, it lasts indefinitely or until the user chooses to use this move again to swap the targets back.
Hyperspace Hole, 5 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Automatically hits. Deals 3d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and it ignores protection moves.
Hypnosis, 20 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, the target falls asleep.
Imprison, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Prevents all individuals in battle from using moves the user knows as long as the user is active in battle.
Instruct, 5 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Instructs a target to use the move it last used again.
Kinesis, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, the target's next attack has disadvantage.
Light Screen, 30 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Creates a light screen around the user and all allies it chooses. For 5 turns, halves the damage of all Special attacks against the targets.

Light That Burns The Sky; Special, Psychic; 30ft radius. Ultra Necrozma's Z-Move, using Photon Geyser. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 8d20 + Special Attack modifier damage. Attacks using Attack or Special Attack, whichever would be more effective against the target, and it ignores all abilities.
Lumina Crash, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and decreases the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
Lunar Blessing, 1 PP; Status, Psychic; 5ft radius. Heals the user and allies in range for 25% of their max HP and removes all status conditions.
Lunar Dance, 1 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. The user faints. The next Pokémon to become active or another active Pokémon heals to full HP and PP and is cured of all status conditions.

Luster Purge, 5 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 3d12 + Special Attack modifier, and on hit, roll a d20. On evens, reduce the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Magic Coat, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. The user reflects all status moves used on them back at the user of the move for the rest of the round.
Magic Powder, 20 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, the target becomes a pure Psychic type.
Magic Room, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Creates a magical room that affects the entire battlefield for 5 turns. All held items become unable to be activated or used for the duration.
Max Mindstorm; Physical or Special, Psychic; 50ft. Psychic type max move. Deals 6d10 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage, and summons psychic terrain centered on the target.
Meditate, 30 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Increases the user's Attack by 1 stage.

Miracle Eye, 30 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack, and on hit, the target cannot impose disadvantage on the attack rolls of others, and if it is a Dark type, it becomes able to be hit by Psychic type moves.
Mirror Coat, 3 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. As a reaction against taking damage from a Special move, deal double the damage dealt to the user back to the target.
Mist Ball, 5 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 3d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d20. On evens, reduces the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Mystical Power, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 3d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and increases the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

Photon Geyser, 5 PP; Special, Psychic; 50ft. Make a separate attack on each target within a 25ft radius of the target. Deals 5d12 + Special Attack modifier damage. Becomes physical and uses Attack if the user's Attack is higher than its Special Attack, and this attack ignores abilities.
Power Split, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Averages the user and target's Attack and Special Attack, then sets the user and target's Attack and Special Attack to the average.
Power Swap, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Swaps the target's Attack and Special Attack with the user's Attack and Special Attack.
Power Trick, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Swaps the user's Attack with its Defense.
Prismatic Laser, 5 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 6d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and the user skips its next turn to recharge.
Psybeam, 20 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft line. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 2d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 10, the target is confused.
Psyblade, 15 PP; Physical, Psychic; 20ft line. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, or 7d10 + Special Attack modifier in electric terrain.
Psychic, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 4d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 10, reduce the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Psychic Fangs, 10 PP; Physical, Psychic; Melee. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier damage, and removes Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil on hit.

Psychic Noise, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target, and on hit, deals 3d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and the target is prevented from healing for the next 2 turns.
Psychic Terrain, 10 PP; Status, Psychic ; 30ft. User creates Psychic Terrain centered on the target point in range.
Psycho Boost, 5 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 5d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and reduces the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
Psycho Cut, 20 PP; Physical, Psychic; Melee. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, and it crits on a 19-20.
Psyshield Bash, 10 PP; Physical, Psychic; Melee. Deals 3d10 + Attack modifier damage, and increases the user's Defense by 1 stage.
Psycho Shift, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Inflicts the target with a status condition the user has, then cures the user of all status conditions.
Psyshock, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 3d12 + Special Attack modifier damage, and attacks against the target's Defense instead of Special Defense.
Psystrike, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft. Deals 4d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, and attacks against the target's Defense instead of Special Defense.
Psywave, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals Xd4 damage, where X is the result of a d20. Cannot hit super effectively or be resisted.
Reflect, 30 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Creates a reflecting screen around the user and all allies it chooses. For 5 turns, halves the damage of all Physical attacks against the targets.
Rest, 1 PP; Status, Psychic; Melee. Restores the user to full HP and causes it to fall asleep, guaranteeing at least 1 turn of sleep.
Role Play, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Replaces the user's ability with one of the target's abilities.
Shattered Psyche; Physical or Special, Psychic; 30ft. Psychic type Z-Move. Deals 8d12 + Attack or Special Attack modifier damage.
Skill Swap, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Swaps the user and target's abilities with one another. If the user or the target has more than one ability, the user chooses which abilities are swapped.
Speed Swap, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Swaps the Speed of the user and target.
Stored Power, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 30ft. Deals 1d6 + Special Attack modifier damage. Adds an additional damage die for each increased stat stage the user has.

Synchronoise, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 5d10 + Special Attack modifier damage, but only if the target shares a typing with the user. This move ignores resistances.
Take Heart, 3 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Cures the user of status conditions and increases its Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Telekinesis, 5 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Make an attack roll using Special Attack. On hit, all attacks made against the target had advantage until the start of its next turn, and for the duration, it becomes immune to Ground type moves, isn't grounded, and cannot move.
Teleport, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. The user teleports up to 60 feet in any direction.
Trick, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; 30ft. Swaps the held items of the user and target.

Trick Room, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. The user must decide to use this move at the start of the round, then acting at the very end of the round. Creates a mysterious room which encompasses the entire battlefield, and for 5 turns, the round order goes from slowest to fastest instead of fastest to slowest.
Twin Beam, 10 PP; Special, Psychic; 15ft line. Make two separate attacks on each target. Deals 2d10 + Special Attack modifier damage.
Wonder Room, 10 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. Creates a magical room that affects the entire battlefield for 5 turns. Swaps the Defense and Special Defense of all active individuals.
Zen Headbutt, 15 PP; Physical, Psychic; Melee. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 9-10, the target flinches.

Fair Share, 5 PP; Status, Normal; 30ft. Choose two different targets within range, giving each target the other's temporary stat changes. If a positive or negative stat change on one target would negate a positive or negative stat change on the other target, the stat changes simply become neutral.
Spring Kick, 5 PP; Physical, Fighting ; Melee. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the user moves up to its highest movement speed in any direction without provoking opportunity attacks.

Winged Flourish, 5 PP; Physical, Flying; Melee. The user makes a separate attack on each target in a 15ft horizontal line in front of it and 5ft on either side of it, dealing 1d10 + Attack modifier damage. For each target hit, this attack gains an additional +1 bonus to damage.
Alchemize, 5 PP; Status, Poison; Self. Increases the user's Defense and Sp. Defense by 1 stage, and its next damage dealing Poison type move deals an additional die of damage.
Sandblast, 5 PP; Special, Ground; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 1d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and on hit, targets are pushed back 15ft away from the user.

Stalagmite, 5 PP; Status, Rock; 25ft. Choose three different spaces within range, creating stalagmites in the chosen spaces that become impassable unless burrowing movement is used, or if the target can climb or fly 15ft over the stalagmite. If a trainer or Pokémon is in a space where a stalagmite is summoned, its movement on its next turn is halved.

Silk Suplex, 5 PP; Physical, Bug; 15ft. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target is moved adjacent to the user, and on hit, the user rolls a d10. On a 10, the target hit by this move cannot take an action on its next turn.

Haunting, 5 PP; Status, Ghost; Self. On use, the user becomes invisible and unable to be seen. While invisible, the user gains an additional 15ft of phasing movement, and if it does not have a phasing movement, it gains 30ft of phasing movement. If the user attacks a target, the attack has advantage and it immediately becomes visible once more.

Metal Mirror, 5 PP; Status, Steel; 25ft. Creates a mirror on the chosen space, and when the user uses a move, it can choose to have the move originate from the mirror's position. If two mirrors are active, if a ranged move is used to originate from one mirror, it forms a straight line to the other mirror to hit all targets in its path. If a mirror is summoned while two mirrors are already active, one of the previous mirrors is destroyed. A mirror can be destroyed with a damaging move, and a mirror has an AC of 10 and an HP of 1.

Firebreathing, 5 PP; Status, Fire; Self. On use, all of the user's moves with a range of melee become a range of a 10ft cone instead. On hit with a damaging move affected by this move, the user can choose to change the damage type to Fire.

Bubble Buster, 5 PP; Physical, Water; Melee. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target is pushed 10ft away from the user and becomes trapped in a bubble, becoming unable to move until the end of its next turn.

Flower Bounce, 5 PP; Status, Grass; 25ft. Creates a large, bouncy flower that allies can move onto in order to move an additional 20ft in any direction. A target can only use a flower to move once per turn, and only one flower can be active at a time. If a flower is summoned while one is already active, the previous flower is destroyed.

Lightningrod Skewer, 5 PP; Physical, Electric; Melee. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target has a lightning rod planted on them. As an action, while a target has a lightning rod planted on them, the user can choose to destroy the lightning rod and instantly paralyze the target.

Cognition Shift, 5 PP; Status, Psychic; 15ft. Make an attack roll based on Sp. Attack against the target. On hit, all of the target's Physical moves become Special moves, and all of the target's Special moves become Physical moves. If a status move they use would useSpecial Attack, it uses Attack instead, and if it would use Attack, it uses Special Attack instead. Alternatively, the user can automatically hit and use this move on itself.

Cold Snap, 5 PP; Physical, Ice; Melee. Deals 1d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 9-10, the target is frostbitten, and if the target is already frostbitten, this attack deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage instead.

Advancing Claw, 5 PP; Physical, Dragon; 15ft line. Make a separate attack on each target, moving to the end of the line. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage, and if the user hits two or more targets with this move, it can use the move a second time.
Shade Shot, 5 PP; Special, Dark; 30ft. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target halves its Defense and Sp. Defense modifiers until the start of its next turn.
Feyspark, 5 PP; Special, Fairy; 20ft. Deals 1d10 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target is confused.

Screechy Outburst, 10 PP; Special, Normal; 15ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. On hit, the target takes 2d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and until the end of its next turn, it takes double damage from all sound based moves.

Ki Burst, 10 PP; Special, Fighting ; 10ft radius. Automatically hits all targets. Deals 2d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage and knocks all hit targets 15ft away from the user, and the next ‘aura' or ‘pulse' move the user uses ignores immunities and resistances.

Howling Gale, 10 PP; Status, Flying; 100ft. The user chooses a 25ft long and 10ft wide area in range, summoning a howling gale in the area. While the gale is active, all allies who move through it can move anywhere in the gale without expending any movement, and all enemies who move through it have their movement speeds halved. A gale created by this move lasts 3 turns before dissipating, and only one gale can be active at one time. If a second gale is created, the first one dissipates.

Toxic Transference, 10 PP; Physical, Poison; 25ft. The user must target an ally or enemy Pokémon that is Poisoned or Badly Poisoned. On use, the user removes the poison from the target, and then makes an attack on a target in range. On hit, the target takes 2d10 + Attack modifier damage and becomes Poisoned or Badly Poisoned, whichever was removed from the original target.

Excavate, 10 PP; Status, Ground; 15ft cube. Creates a 15ft cube of difficult terrain centered on the user, and all targets who are burrowing in range are forced to the surface and take 4d10 typeless damage. The difficult terrain cannot be passed by burrowing movement, and all Ground type moves used by the user while in the terrain double the STAB modifier for attack and damage rolls.

Crystal Cannon, 10 PP; Special, Rock; Self. On use, summons a crystal adjacent to the user: at the end of each of the user's turns, the crystal fires at a target within 30ft of it, automatically hitting and dealing 1d10 + Sp. Attack modifier Rock damage. Only one crystal can be summoned by the user, and if another is summoned, the previous crystal is destroyed. A crystal stays on the field for 3 turns after being summoned.

Pheromone Spray, 10 PP; Special, Bug; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 2d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target has its Defense reduced by 2 stages, and it takes super effective damage from the next Bug type move it's hit by.

Possession, 10 PP; Status, Ghost; 15ft. Make an attack roll based on Sp. Attack against the target. On hit, the user moves into the target's space and possesses it, controlling what the target does on its next turn, including where it moves, what action it takes, and if it attacks an ally or an enemy with a move or weapon. At the end of that turn, the user moves 10ft away from the target without provoking opportunity attacks. This move cannot be used on a target more than once per battle.

Magnetize, 10 PP; Special, Steel; 30ft. Make attacks on each target within a 15ft radius, centered around the target. On hit, a target is dragged to the center of the radius, and targets take 1d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. For each target hit by the attack, the damage of the move gains an additional die.

Solar Fist, 10 PP; Physical, Fire; Melee. Deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 9-10, the target is burned. If this move is used when harsh sunlight is active, the target is also pushed back 15ft on hit and is automatically burnt.
Gaia Geyser, 10 PP; Special, Water; 30ft. Deals 4d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target is pushed 25ft away from the user and forces the user to skip its next turn to recharge.

Allergen Bomb, 10 PP; Special, Grass; 25ft. Make attacks on each target within a 10ft radius, centered around the target. Deals 2d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 9-10, the target is confused, and if the target is already confused, it is guaranteed to be fully confused on its next turn.

Static Eruption, 10 PP; Special, Electric; 15ft. Deals 2d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. If the target was last hit by a damaging Electric type move, this move deals 4d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage instead.

Psyche Slam, 10 PP; Physical, Psychic; 20ft. On hit, make a second attack roll against a different target within 15ft of the first with advantage. On a miss, the first target takes 2d10 + Attack modifier damage. On a hit, both targets take 2d12 + Attack modifier damage.

Permafrost, 10 PP; Special, Ice; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 2d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. If the weather is snowy, this move has a range of a 30ft cone and deals 4d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage instead.

Draken Wings, 10 PP; Status, Dragon; Self. For the next 3 turns, the user gains a flying speed of 30ft, doubles its STAB bonus for Dragon type moves, and if it doesn't have STAB with Dragon type moves, it gains STAB. Additionally, the user gains all the resistances of a pure Dragon type Pokémon on top of resistances they currently have.

Grim Hold, 10 PP; Physical, Dark; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. If you hit two or more targets, choose one of the targets to move adjacent to you, dealing 3d12 + Attack modifier damage to that target. All other targets take 1d12 + Attack modifier damage and are pushed 10ft away from you.

Spirit Sword, 10 PP; Physical, Fairy; Melee. Deals 2d12 + Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the user can dash up to 15ft in any direction without provoking opportunity attacks. If the user moves adjacent to another target with this movement, it can roll to hit against them with this move again without expending additional PP. The user can only move like this once per turn.

Balanced Attack, 15 PP; Physical, Normal; Melee. This attack uses the higher of the user's Attack and Sp. Attack stats, and targets the lower of the target's Defense and Sp. Defense stats. Deals 4d12 + Attack/Sp. Attack modifier damage.

5-Star Strike, 15 PP; Physical, Fighting ; 25ft radius. Choose five different spaces within range, connecting each space from one to another in a straight line. The user then makes a separate attack on each target in all of the lines, dealing 3d12 + Attack modifier damage on hit.

Perfect Storm, 15 PP; Special, Flying; 30ft. Make attacks on each target within a 10ft radius, centered around the target. Deals 3d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. If harsh sunlight, rain, a sandstorm, or snow is active, this attack deals an additional 2d12 + Sp. Attack modifier Fire, Water, Rock, or Ice damage respectively.

Venom Absorption, 15 PP; Special, Poison; 15ft cone. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 4d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the user heals a number of HP equal to 1/4 of the poison damage taken by ALL trainers and Pokémon in combat, removing the Poisoned or Badly Poisoned conditions from them.

Shifting Sands, 15 PP; Special, Ground; 25ft radius. Make a separate attack on each target. Deals 3d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and on hit, roll a d10. On a 9-10, the target is forced to skip its next turn.

Stone Prison, 15 PP; Physical, Rock; 20ft. The user moves adjacent to the target before making the attack roll. On hit, deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage, and the user surrounds itself with a spherical barrier of stone that stretches 20ft in all directions, including up and down. While the barrier is active, the user and target cannot leave it unless the user or target faints, and any other targets that would be inside the barrier when it is created are shoved out of the area and become unable to enter it. Only one of these barriers can be active at any one time, and this move cannot be used while a barrier is active.

String-Up, 15 PP; Status, Bug; 20ft. Make an attack roll using Attack on the target, and on hit, the target is encapsulated in sticky silk. It skips all of its turns, and at the end of its turn, it can roll a DC 20 Power/Attack check to free itself from the silk. For every turn that passes, the DC decreases by 2.
Phasing Slash, 15 PP; Physical, Ghost; Melee. This move halves the Defense modifier of the target before rolling to hit and deal damage. Deals 3d12 + Attack modifier damage.
Metalicize, 15 PP; Status, Steel; Self. Grants the user a +1 bonus to its Physical and Special AC. This move can only be used every other turn.

Phoenix Flame, 15 PP; Special, Fire; 30ft. Deals 3d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. If an ally has fainted or died during the round, this attack deals 6d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage instead, and on hit, roll a d10. On an 8-10, the target is burnt.

Downpour, 15 PP; Special, Water; Melee. Deals 3d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. If the weather is rainy, the attack gains an additional 2d12 damage and is able to push the target up to 15ft in any direction.
Barbed Vine, 15 PP; Physical, Grass; 15ft. Deals 4d10 + Attack modifier Grass or Poison damage, whichever would be more effective.

Smite, 15 PP; Special, Electric; 100ft. Deals 8d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and on hit, the target becomes paralyzed and cannot move until the end of its next turn. Until the start of the user's next turn, it takes double damage from attacks, and attacks can't miss.

Metacognition, 15 PP; Status, Psychic; Self. For the next 3 turns, once per turn, the user can choose to have any attack that hits it to deal half damage. Alternatively, the user can choose to have any attack it hits to ignore immunities and resistances.

Absolute Zero, 15 PP; Special, Ice; Melee. Deals 4d10 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. If the target is at or below 10% of its maximum HP, it automatically faints when being damaged by this move. If the target is frostbitten, the target automatically faints when it is at or below 20% of its maximum HP instead.

Dragonfire, 15 PP; Special, Dragon; 30ft line. Make a separate attack on each target, moving to the end of the line. Deals 3d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage, and if this move knocks out a target, it can be used again.

Void Shift, 15 PP; Status, Dark; 30ft radius. Make a separate attack based on Attack against each target. On hit, the target has all of its positive stat changes reduced to neutral, and any negative stat changes they have decreased by an additional 1 stage.

Mist Wave, 15 PP; Special, Fairy; 25ft line. Deals 3d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage. If Misty Terrain is active, the move becomes a 25ft cone and deals 5d12 + Sp. Attack modifier damage instead, and the move ignores all target's positive stat changes.
